schema:
CREATE TABLE dbo.activity_log (
id BIGINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
log_name NVARCHAR(255) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
description NVARCHAR(max) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
subject_type NVARCHAR(255) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
subject_id BIGINT NULL,
causer_type NVARCHAR(255) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
causer_id BIGINT NULL,
properties NVARCHAR(max) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
created_at DATETIME NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NULL,
event NVARCHAR(255) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
batch_uuid UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.app_info (
app_uuid CHAR(36) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
app_title NVARCHAR(100) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
activation_code NVARCHAR(max) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
status NVARCHAR(max) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
activated_at DATETIME NULL,
blocked_at DATETIME NULL
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.audits (
id BIGINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
user_type NVARCHAR(255) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
user_id BIGINT NULL,
event NVARCHAR(255) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
auditable_type NVARCHAR(255) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
auditable_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
old_values NVARCHAR(max) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
new_values NVARCHAR(max) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
url NVARCHAR(max) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
ip_address NVARCHAR(45) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
user_agent NVARCHAR(1023) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
tags NVARCHAR(255) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.cities (
id BIGINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
province_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id),
FOREIGN KEY(province_id) REFERENCES dbo.provinces (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.configuration_items (
id SMALLINT NOT NULL,
updater_id SMALLINT NULL,
name NVARCHAR(100) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
item_key VARCHAR(100) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
item_value NVARCHAR(max) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.continents (
id BIGINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.countries (
id BIGINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
continent_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
is_home_country BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ('0'),
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id),
FOREIGN KEY(continent_id) REFERENCES dbo.continents (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.department_categories (
id BIGINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
name NVARCHAR(300) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
is_headquarter BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ((0)),
is_readonly BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ((0)),
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.department_types (
id BIGINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
name NVARCHAR(100) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
is_readonly BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ((0)),
supervisor_grade_id TINYINT NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id),
FOREIGN KEY(supervisor_grade_id) REFERENCES dbo.grades (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.departments (
id SMALLINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
uuid CHAR(36) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
name NVARCHAR(100) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
is_readonly BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ((0)),
department_number NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
parent_id BIGINT NULL,
left_id BIGINT NULL,
right_id BIGINT NULL,
department_type_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
department_category_id BIGINT NULL,
logo_image NVARCHAR(max) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id),
FOREIGN KEY(department_type_id) REFERENCES dbo.department_types (id),
FOREIGN KEY(department_category_id) REFERENCES dbo.department_categories (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.document_directors (
id INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
document_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
sex_id TINYINT NOT NULL,
first_name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
last_name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id),
FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES dbo.documents (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
FOREIGN KEY(sex_id) REFERENCES dbo.sexes (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.document_kinds (
id TINYINT NOT NULL,
name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
code VARCHAR(20) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.document_machine_tag (
document_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
machine_tag_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
count TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT ((1)),
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (document_id, machine_tag_id),
FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES dbo.documents (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
FOREIGN KEY(machine_tag_id) REFERENCES dbo.machine_tags (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.document_manual_tag (
document_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
manual_tag_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
count TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT ((1)),
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (document_id, manual_tag_id),
FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES dbo.documents (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
FOREIGN KEY(manual_tag_id) REFERENCES dbo.manual_tags (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.document_owners (
id INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
department_id SMALLINT NOT NULL,
document_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
is_current BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ((1)),
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id),
FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES dbo.documents (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.document_profile (
document_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
profile_id SMALLINT NOT NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (document_id, profile_id),
FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES dbo.documents (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
FOREIGN KEY(profile_id) REFERENCES dbo.profiles (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.document_signatories (
id INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
document_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
sex_id TINYINT NOT NULL,
first_name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
last_name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id),
FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES dbo.documents (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
FOREIGN KEY(sex_id) REFERENCES dbo.sexes (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.document_subject (
document_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
subject_id TINYINT NOT NULL,
created_at DATETIME NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (document_id, subject_id),
FOREIGN KEY(subject_id) REFERENCES dbo.subjects (id),
FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES dbo.documents (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.documents (
id INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
file_id INTEGER NULL,
text_genre_id TINYINT NULL,
language_id TINYINT NULL,
issue_origin_id TINYINT NULL,
text_type_id TINYINT NULL,
document_kind_id TINYINT NULL,
publish_method_id TINYINT NULL,
body NVARCHAR(max) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
title NVARCHAR(250) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
source NVARCHAR(200) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
view_count SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT ((0)),
published_at DATETIME NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id),
FOREIGN KEY(publish_method_id) REFERENCES dbo.publish_methods (id),
FOREIGN KEY(document_kind_id) REFERENCES dbo.document_kinds (id),
FOREIGN KEY(file_id) REFERENCES dbo.files (id),
FOREIGN KEY(issue_origin_id) REFERENCES dbo.issue_origins (id),
FOREIGN KEY(language_id) REFERENCES dbo.languages (id),
FOREIGN KEY(text_genre_id) REFERENCES dbo.text_genres (id),
FOREIGN KEY(text_type_id) REFERENCES dbo.text_types (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.exceptions (
id BIGINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
user_id BIGINT NULL,
ip_address NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
message NVARCHAR(max) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
trace NVARCHAR(max) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
code NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.failed_jobs (
id BIGINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
uuid NVARCHAR(255) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
connection NVARCHAR(max) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
queue NVARCHAR(max) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
payload NVARCHAR(max) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
exception NVARCHAR(max) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
failed_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (getdate()),
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX unique_1 ON dbo.failed_jobs (uuid);
CREATE TABLE dbo.files (
id INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
file_size INTEGER NOT NULL,
mime_type VARCHAR(100) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
file_content VARBINARY(max) NOT NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.grades (
id TINYINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
is_readonly BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ((0)),
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.issue_origins (
id TINYINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
is_readonly BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ((0)),
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.languages (
id TINYINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
is_readonly BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ((0)),
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.machine_tags (
id INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
name NVARCHAR(100) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.manual_tags (
id INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
name NVARCHAR(100) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.migrations (
id INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
migration NVARCHAR(255) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
batch INTEGER NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.password_resets (
email NVARCHAR(255) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
token NVARCHAR(255) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
created_at DATETIME NULL
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.people (
id INTEGER NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
first_name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
last_name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
is_readonly BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ((0)),
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.permission_role (
id BIGINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
permission_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
role_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id),
FOREIGN KEY(permission_id) REFERENCES dbo.permissions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
FOREIGN KEY(role_id) REFERENCES dbo.roles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.permission_sets (
id BIGINT NOT NULL,
name NVARCHAR(100) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
order_no TINYINT NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.permission_user (
user_id SMALLINT NOT NULL,
permission_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (user_id, permission_id),
FOREIGN KEY(permission_id) REFERENCES dbo.permissions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES dbo.users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.permissions (
id BIGINT NOT NULL,
permission_set_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
name NVARCHAR(100) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
code NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.personal_access_tokens (
id BIGINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
tokenable_type NVARCHAR(255) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
tokenable_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
name NVARCHAR(255) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
token NVARCHAR(64) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
abilities NVARCHAR(max) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
last_used_at DATETIME NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX unique_1 ON dbo.personal_access_tokens (token);
CREATE TABLE dbo.profiles (
id SMALLINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
parent_id SMALLINT NULL,
user_id SMALLINT NOT NULL,
department_id SMALLINT NOT NULL,
grade_id TINYINT NOT NULL,
is_enable BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ('1'),
is_current BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ('1'),
description NVARCHAR(200) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id),
FOREIGN KEY(department_id) REFERENCES dbo.departments (id),
FOREIGN KEY(grade_id) REFERENCES dbo.grades (id),
FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES dbo.users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.provinces (
id BIGINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
country_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id),
FOREIGN KEY(country_id) REFERENCES dbo.countries (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.publish_methods (
id TINYINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
publish_type_id TINYINT NOT NULL,
is_readonly BIT NULL DEFAULT ((0)),
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id),
FOREIGN KEY(publish_type_id) REFERENCES dbo.publish_types (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.publish_types (
id TINYINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
is_readonly BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ((0)),
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.role_user (
user_id SMALLINT NOT NULL,
role_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
created_at DATETIME NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (user_id, role_id),
FOREIGN KEY(role_id) REFERENCES dbo.roles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES dbo.users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.roles (
id BIGINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
name NVARCHAR(100) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.sexes (
id TINYINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
name NVARCHAR(20) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
prefix NVARCHAR(20) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
is_readonly BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ((0)),
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.subject_types (
id TINYINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
is_readonly BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ((0)),
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.subjects (
id TINYINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
subject_type_id TINYINT NOT NULL,
is_readonly BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ((0)),
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id),
FOREIGN KEY(subject_type_id) REFERENCES dbo.subject_types (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.tag_types (
id TINYINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
is_manual BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ((0)),
is_auto BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ((0)),
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.text_genres (
id TINYINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
is_readonly BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ((0)),
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.text_types (
id TINYINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
name NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
is_readonly BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ((0)),
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id)
);
CREATE TABLE dbo.users (
id SMALLINT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
uuid NVARCHAR(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
sex_id TINYINT NULL,
username NVARCHAR(100) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
first_name NVARCHAR(100) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
last_name NVARCHAR(100) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NOT NULL,
employment_no INTEGER NULL,
password NVARCHAR(200) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
privileges_code NVARCHAR(200) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
is_active BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT ('1'),
started_at DATETIME NULL,
finished_at DATETIME NULL,
two_factor_secret NVARCHAR(255) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
two_factor_recovery_codes NVARCHAR(255) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS NULL,
two_factor_confirmed_at DATETIME NULL,
password_expired_at DATETIME NULL,
first_login_at DATETIME NULL,
last_login_at DATETIME NULL,
last_access_at DATETIME NULL,
expired_at DATETIME NULL,
blocked_at DATETIME NULL,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
deleted_at DATETIME NULL,
PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (id),
FOREIGN KEY(sex_id) REFERENCES dbo.sexes (id)
);
